shipLog.text: ◆ At every stop, press STOP for the full menu of services! Every action has a time cost and an effort cost! RESUME when you're done! Enjoy!
◆ Seeds planted! CHIP has enrolled your crop in GrowCo™ Rewards! You are now earning points! Points cannot be redeemed in space!
NOW ARRIVING: Asteroid Field 1! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ AJOY files a reference beside the hive's entry: honeybees have flown in space before, and learned to build comb without gravity, eventually.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Hive: “Turn back and hand them over”! BOLD leadership!
You turn back, which costs fuel and an apologetic call to traffic… RESULTS: +3 MORALE, −3 FUEL, 2 DAYS! ★★★★★
◆ You have materials! Why buy when you can print? The FABRICATOR is in the Stop menu! Prints take a few days! Wear is normal! Probably!
NOW ARRIVING: Site B (Site A Is Classified)! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
Also: −1 O2.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Sleet: “Bow into it and take the sleet”! BOLD leadership!
You turn the armored bow into the stream and let it hiss… RESULTS: −5 HULL, −3 H2O, 1 DAY. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ Your cargo hold is a treasure chest! INV opens it! SELL at stations for gold! JETTISON if you must! CHIP prefers SELL!
NOW ARRIVING: The Refueling Opportunity! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
Also: −1 O2.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Fever Ward: “Buy through the airlock and stay sealed”! BOLD leadership!
You stay sealed and do your business through the cargo… RESULTS: −9 GOLD, −1 MORALE, 1 DAY. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ Waved off at The Refueling Opportunity — no berth, so no market, medbay, drydock or fab service this stop.
◆ Welcome to the station! Every service is open: MARKET, MEDBAY, DRYDOCK, FAB SERVICE! Gold accepted! CHIP's favourite place in the universe!
GROWBAY UPDATE: Soybean hit VEGETATIVE! 30% grown, health 97. INVEST!
NOW ARRIVING: Planet McPlanetface! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.

identity.name: Ines Vahl
identity.story: They map places for a survey office that stopped paying them two years ago. They kept mapping. They stowed away because your route crosses three sectors whose charts they know to be wrong, and being aboard a ship headed into a known error was, professionally speaking, irresistible.
identity.line: Your nav charts are wrong at marker sixty-one. Charmingly wrong. Fatally wrong. May I see the helm?
identity.join_note: Draws corrections directly onto official charts in pen. The pen is the statement.

fee.detail: Festival week. The festival is mandatory.
